mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMENT ( COMENT_ID, MEM_ID, BOARD_ID, COMENT_CONTENT, COMENT_DATE )VALUES( 'C'||COMENT_SEQ.NEXTVAL, (SELECT MEM_ID FROM MEMBER WHERE MEM_LOGIN_ID = #{memLoginId}), #{boardId}, #{comentContent}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select:
SELECT A.COMENT_ID, B.MEM_NICK, A.COMENT_CONTENT, A.COMENT_DATE FROM COMENT A INNER JOIN MEMBER B ON (A.MEM_ID = B.MEM_ID)
A.COMENT_END IS NULL AND A.BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
AND A.MEM_ID = (SELECT MEM_ID FROM MEMBER WHERE MEM_LOGIN_ID = #{memLoginId})
ORDER BY A.COMENT_DATE
mapper.update: UPDATE COMENT SET COMENT_END = SYSDATE WHERE COMENT_ID = #{comentId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM COMENT c INNER JOIN MEMBER m ON c.mem_ID = m.mem_ID WHERE M.MEM_NICK IN (SELECT MEM_NICK FROM MEMBER WHERE MEM_login_id=#{memLoginId})
